request.prompt: Detect all objects in this image. Output JSON with the key detections holding a list of objects with label and box_2d. Each box_2d must be [x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max]: top-left and bottom-right corners in absolute pixel coordinates of this 1024x768 pixel image. Only use these labels: ["pill"]. Detect every visible individual pill/tablet. Include its full visible extent; for partly obscured pills estimate the full shape from visible portions. Exclude shadows, reflections, and objects too indistinct to identify as pills. Return {"detections":[]} if no objects are present.
